coverage.purpose: Fill the three missing annual-rate years in the Vancouver councillor series.

sources.title: City of Vancouver — Mayor and Councillor Remuneration By-law 11483, 2016 rates
sources.locator: Sections 3.1–3.3 (2016 salary and supplement); sections 4.1–4.2 (annual adjustments); section 6.2 and enactment
notes: The consolidated official bylaw expressly preserves the 2016 base rates in sections 3.2 and 3.3. It was enacted April 5, 2016; the annual supplement commenced May 1, 2016.
The $3,048 annual supplement and the separate one-time payments in Part 2 are not included in these base rates. One-time payments must not be interpreted as recurring salary.
The 2016 mayor amount is the explicitly enacted $161,308.02. The 2.02 multiplier applies commencing January 1, 2017; it is not used to recompute the stated 2016 rate.
Transcribed from the official PDF text. No original downloaded-file hash is claimed.

sources.title: City of Vancouver — 2018 Council Remuneration and Expenses, November 27, 2017
sources.locator: Annual Salaries comparison table and detailed annual adjustment schedule for 2017 and 2018
notes: The published comparison table explicitly states the annual salaries for 2017 and 2018. No historical salaries were inferred from the inflation index.

The separately prescribed $3,048 annual supplement is recorded from By-law 11483 section 3.1; expense and transportation allowances, discretionary funds and extra duties are excluded from base salary.
The memo states that the 2018 adjustment takes effect January 1, 2018. January 1 annual adjustments from 2017 are also specified in By-law 11483 sections 4.1–4.2.
Transcribed from the official PDF text. No original downloaded-file hash is claimed.
